purpose: Evaluator-only truth for the v0.7 operational-realism replay pack.

cases.expected_failure_mode: partial repair followed by misleading later state in reconciliation workflow
patch_family_judgment: fix should address both the repair pass and the later verification path
fix should not treat first apparent convergence as final correctness

cases.expected_failure_mode: ambiguous success response treated too optimistically in approval flow
patch_family_judgment: fix should require an explicit success signal and fail closed on ambiguous 200 responses
fix should align approval path configuration with contract-safe interpretation

cases.expected_failure_mode: later state drift across refresh, rollover, and publisher update surfaces
patch_family_judgment: fix should align rollover behavior across refresh, helper, and publisher surfaces
fix should address delayed stale-state behavior rather than only local arithmetic

cases.expected_failure_mode: summary flow depended on missing context assembly and fallback handling before remote call
patch_family_judgment: safe containment is acceptable if full resolution is not yet possible
fix should repair partner or brand context assembly as well as handler fallback behavior
fix should not collapse into a single local field patch

cases.expected_failure_mode: refresh rollover not applied in one narrow expired-order task path
patch_family_judgment: fix should remain localized to task ordering and conditional rollover handling
fix should not require broad propagation rewiring

cases.expected_failure_mode: publisher refresh reset state because one compact update path lacked the correct preservation behavior
patch_family_judgment: fix should stay in the narrow publisher update surface or a safe containment wrapper
fix should not require broad refresh-sequencing or system-wide state rewrites
cases.notes: Prune-deserving noisy single-surface case with containment-oriented outcome.

cases.expected_failure_mode: local response handling mapped counts and collections incorrectly despite valid upstream data
patch_family_judgment: fix should stay in the local handler mapping layer
fix should correct collection and total extraction rather than broad upstream instability
cases.notes: Prune-deserving mapping case with distracting noise.

cases.expected_failure_mode: gateway auth failure caused by one narrow lookup-route construction bug
patch_family_judgment: fix should stay in the gateway auth boundary and route construction logic
fix should not broaden into credential rotation or cross-service auth redesign
